headline: SKIL Infrastructure Limited enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process; Resolution Plans received by RP
sum: SKIL Infrastructure Limited, admitted into CIRP under IBC 2016, has received Resolution Plans from prospective bidders. The company notified the NSE of the milestone, signalling the commencement of competitive bidding phase in the insolvency process.
detail: SKIL Infrastructure Limited has been admitted into a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The company's Resolution Professional has received Resolution Plans from prospective bidders within the statutory 180-day window. This disclosure to the NSE marks the transition from the pre-bid phase to evaluation and approval by the Committee of Creditors, a critical juncture where competing restructuring proposals will be assessed against the objective of value maximisation and debt recovery.
